{{Conjecture|legends}}
The '''father''' of [[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]] owned and operated a [[space barge]] fleet which ferried cargo and passengers throughout the [[Chandrila system/Legends|Chandrila system]]. When he fell ill, his son returned from studying at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] to take over the family business.<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref>
